what: Eight-track drum synthesizer for the FM-1 with its own sound engine: 26 settings per track, step sequencer with p-locks and chance, patterns and song mode, reverb, delay, sidechain, MIDI and CC control. Try it in your browser first.
author: Luigi Rossi
sounds: licensed: ER-99 cymbal samples (hh, ride, crash) by Matthew Cieplak, shipped by 9W9 by Charles Vestal, GPL-3.0
